# ModelCredential

A tenant's own credential for a model provider (collection `modelCredential`). It holds:

- a provider;
- its keys, tried in order;
- the models it may serve, with any deployment names;
- an optional endpoint (none means the provider's public API);
- an optional tag for grouping.

Runs never name a credential directly: they use a `CredentialStack` of them.

Secrets are write-only. They're accepted on create and update and never served, and only `ModelCredentialKey.KeyHint` identifies a key. A credential belongs to one tenant: every lookup is by tenant, and another tenant's id reads as not found.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Unique within the tenant. |
| `description` | `string \| null` |  |
| `provider` | [`ModelKeyProvider`](model-key-provider.md) |  |
| `kind` | [`CredentialKind`](credential-kind.md) |  |
| `endpoint` | `string \| null` | The endpoint to call; null for the provider's public API. Always HTTPS on the public internet. |
| `endpointKind` | [`CredentialEndpointKind`](credential-endpoint-kind.md) | Worked out from `ModelCredential.Provider`, `ModelCredential.Endpoint` and `ModelCredential.Cloud` when the credential is saved. |
| `cloud` | [`CredentialCloud`](credential-cloud.md)`\| null` | For an Anthropic credential, Claude on Amazon Bedrock or Google Vertex AI instead of Anthropic's API (with no `ModelCredential.Endpoint`). Null for every other credential. |
| `keys` | [`ModelCredentialKey`](model-credential-key.md)`[]` |  |
| `oAuth` | [`ModelCredentialOAuth`](model-credential-o-auth.md)`\| null` | The subscription sign-in of an OAuth credential; null for an API-key credential, which has `ModelCredential.Keys` instead. |
| `models` | [`CredentialModel`](credential-model.md)`[]` | The models it may serve; empty for any of the provider's models. |
| `tag` | `string \| null` | A label for grouping, such as one caller's customer; credentials can be listed and deleted by tag. |
| `externalTenantRef` | `string \| null` | The tenant in the calling system that owns this credential, as `<system>:<id>`; null when the owner isn't known. Set once, when the credential is created, and never changed. |
| `health` | [`CredentialHealth`](credential-health.md) |  |
| `createdByUserId` | `uuid \| null` |  |
| `revision` | `integer` | Goes up by one each time the credential is changed: edited, signed in again, or its tokens refreshed. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |
